messages.content: what is join in SQL? how to implement full outer join in MySQL?

A SQL JOIN combines rows from two or more tables based on related columns. In MySQL, FULL OUTER JOIN is supported starting from version 8.0. For older versions, simulate it using a UNION of LEFT JOIN and RIGHT JOIN on the same condition. Example:  
`SELECT ... FROM table1 LEFT JOIN table2 ON ...`  
`UNION ALL`  
`SELECT ... FROM table1 RIGHT JOIN table2 ON ...`
